arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/tmp/t_pipecompose.py <<'PYEOF'
# transitive composition with a diamond: entry -> f1, entry -> f2, f1 -> g, f2 -> g
import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
modules = [
  {"name": "entry", "params": [["a", "U8"], ["b", "U8"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
  {"name": "f1", "params": [["p", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
   "requires": ["lt", ["var", "p"], ["const", "U8", 5]]},
  {"name": "f2", "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
   "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 5]]},
  {"name": "g", "params": [["u", "U8"]], "result": ["og", "U8"],
   "requires": ["ne", ["var", "u"], ["const", "U8", 3]]},
]
pipes = [
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"p": "a"}},
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"q": "b"}},
  {"target": "f1", "filter": "g", "bind": {"u": "p"}},
  {"target": "f2", "filter": "g", "bind": {"u": "q"}},
]
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": None, "runs": []}
g = run(doc)
print("modules", g["plans"][0]["modules"], "flag", g["plans"][0]["flag"])
# harness: a x0, b x1, r x2, flag x3
def mk(a, b, r, flag):
    return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest([obj("x0", a, 1), obj("x1", b, 1), obj("x2", r, 1), obj("x3", flag, 1)])}
# g is applied twice with different bindings (u<-a and u<-b)
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, 2, 0, 0)]
assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
doc["runs"] = [mk(3, 1, 0, 0)]        # g(u=a=3) rejects
assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, 3, 0, 0)]        # g(u=b=3) rejects
assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
doc["runs"] = [mk(9, 1, 0, 1)]        # f1 rejects -> flag must be 1
assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
print("PASS diamond composition with distinct bindings")

# same filter, identical composed bindings reached twice -> one application
pipes2 = [
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"p": "a"}},
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"q": "a"}},
  {"target": "f1", "filter": "g", "bind": {"u": "p"}},
  {"target": "f2", "filter": "g", "bind": {"u": "q"}},
]
doc["pipes"] = pipes2
doc["runs"] = [mk(3, 1, 0, 1)]        # g(u=a=3) rejects; f2(q=a=3) also rejects
assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
print("PASS deduplicated identical composed applications")
PYEOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/t_pipecompose.py
